translations.answer: The original thread requested alignment between the VR and ZED coordinate systems. The project contributor confirmed there is an offset between them, which must be resolved before real-time teleoperation. The post does not provide calibration algorithms or transformation matrices, so specific calculation steps cannot be inferred from the replies.
translations.applicability: This applies to human2humanoid remote operation scenarios that use both VR targets and ZED VIO world coordinates.
